name: find-free-time
description: Finds free time on Google Calendar: the open slots of at least a given length (30 minutes by default) in a time window, by default the next seven days, with the busy periods merged across one or more calendars, to check availability before scheduling a meeting. Declined, cancelled and free (transparent) events do not count as busy. calendarIds defaults to ["primary"]; google-calendar__list-calendars supplies others.

calendarIds.description: Calendar IDs to check. Defaults to primary.

timeMin.description: Start of the search window in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to now.

timeMax.description: End of the search window in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to seven days after timeMin.

minMinutes.description: Shortest free slot to return, in minutes. Defaults to 30.
